class="text-rich-text BlogPostDetail-module-scss-module__oel_OW__subheading"><p class="text-body-large-2">Claude 3 Haiku can now be fine-tuned in Amazon Bedrock with custom training data, enabling ArticleLayout-module-scss-module__W3addq__wrap"><div class="ArticleLayout-module-scss-module__W3addq__content"><div class="text-rich-text text-rich-text--article w-richtext"><figure style="--media-natural-width:2880px"><img referrerPolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" src="https://assets.claude.com/f79092f7aee0e94afa919099ab82ea8a13725592.png" width="2880" height="1620" alt="Graph showing fine-tuning with Claude 3 Haiku" loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="Media-module-scss-module__7ZZCyW__image" style="background-image:url(&quot;data:image/png;base64,&quot;);background-size:cover;background-position:center;background-repeat:no-repeat"/></figure><p><em><strong>Update: </strong>Fine-tuning Claude 3 Haiku in Amazon Bedrock is generally available. (November 1, 2024)</em></p><p>Customers can now fine-tune Claude 3 Haiku—our fastest and most cost-effective model—in <a href="https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock/claude/">Amazon Bedrock</a> to customize its knowledge and capabilities for their business, making the model more effective for specialized tasks.</p><h2 id="overview-of-fine-tuning">Overview of fine-tuning</h2><p>Fine-tuning is a popular technique to improve model performance. By creating a customized version of the model, you can train the model to excel at highly tailored workflows.</p><p>To fine-tune Claude 3 Haiku, you first prepare a set of high quality prompt-completion pairs—the ideal outputs that you want Claude to provide for a given task. The fine-tuning API, now available in preview, will use your data to create your own custom Claude 3 Haiku. Using the Amazon Bedrock console or API, you can test and refine your custom Claude 3 Haiku model until it meets your performance goals and is ready for deployment.</p><h2 id="benefits">Benefits</h2><p>Fine-tuning allows you to customize Claude 3 Haiku so it can acquire specialized business knowledge, leading to improved accuracy and consistency. Benefits include:</p><ul><li><strong>Better results on specialized tasks</strong>: Enhance performance for domain-specific actions such as classification, interactions with custom APIs, or industry-specific data interpretation. Fine-tuning allows Claude 3 Haiku to excel in areas crucial to your business compared to more general models by encoding company and domain knowledge.</li><li><strong>Faster speeds at lower cost</strong>: Reduce costs for production deployments where Claude 3 Haiku can be used in place of Sonnet or Opus, while also returning results faster.</li><li><strong>Consistent, brand-aligned formatting</strong>: Generate consistently structured outputs tailored to your exact specifications like standardized reports or custom schemas, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and internal protocols.</li><li><strong>Easy-to-use API</strong>: Companies of all sizes can innovate efficiently without extensive in-house AI expertise or resources. Anyone can fine-tune models seamlessly, no deep technical expertise required.</li><li><strong>Safe and secure</strong>: Proprietary training data remains within customers’ AWS environment. Anthropic’s fine-tuning technique preserves the Claude 3 model family’s low risk of harmful outputs.</li></ul><p>We fine-tuned Haiku to moderate online comments on internet forums1, including identifying insults, threats, and explicit content. Fine-tuning improved classification accuracy from 81.5% to 99.6% while reducing tokens per query by 85%.</p><figure style="--media-natural-width:2200px"><img referrerPolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" src="https://assets.claude.com/a503580b58aa9485eb095e090a78708129424a36.png" width="2200" height="1936" alt="Graph illustrating fine-tuning on Claude 3 Haiku" loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="Media-module-scss-module__7ZZCyW__image" style="background-image:url(&quot;data:image/png;base64,&quot;);background-size:cover;background-position:center;background-repeat:no-repeat"/></figure><h2 id="customer-spotlight">Customer spotlight</h2><p><a href="https://www.claude.com/customers/skt">SK Telecom</a>, one of the largest telecommunications operators in South Korea, trained a custom Claude model to improve support workflows and enable better customer experiences by leveraging their industry-specific expertise.</p><p>&quot;Embedding a fine-tuned Claude in our customer support operations has measurably improved our internal processes and overall customer satisfaction. <strong>By customizing Claude, we&#x27;ve seen a 73% increase in positive feedback for our agents&#x27; responses and a 37% improvement in key performance indicators for telecommunications-related tasks</strong>. The fine-tuned model now efficiently generates topics, action items, and summaries from customer call logs, and breaks down complex customer issues into manageable steps for better problem-solving,&quot; said Eric Davis, Vice President, AI Tech Collaboration Group.</p><p><a href="https://www.claude.com/customers/thomson-reuters">Thomson Reuters</a>, a global content and technology company, has seen positive results with Claude 3 Haiku. The company, which serves professionals in legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media, anticipates even faster and more relevant AI results by fine-tuning Claude with their industry expertise.</p><p>“We are excited to fine-tune Anthropic’s Claude 3 Haiku model in Amazon Bedrock to further enhance our Claude-powered solutions. Thomson Reuters aims to provide accurate, fast, and consistent user experiences. By optimizing Claude around our industry expertise and specific requirements, we anticipate measurable improvements that deliver high-quality results at even faster speeds. <strong>We’ve already seen positive results with Claude 3 Haiku, and fine-tuning will enable us to tailor AI assistance more precisely</strong>,” said Joel Hron, Head of AI and Labs, Thomson Reuters.<br/></p><h2 id="how-to-get-started">How to get started</h2><p>Fine-tuning for Claude 3 Haiku in Amazon Bedrock is now available in preview in the US West (Oregon) AWS Region. At launch, we&#x27;re supporting text-based fine-tuning with context lengths up to 32K tokens, with plans to introduce vision capabilities in the future. Additional details are available in the <a href="https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/fine-tune-anthropics-claude-3-haiku-in-amazon-bedrock-to-boost-model-accuracy-and-quality/">AWS launch blog</a> and <a href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/custom-model-supported.html">documentation</a>.</p><p>To request access, contact your AWS account team or submit a support ticket in the <a href="https://console.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/">AWS Management Console</a>.</p></div></div></div></div><section class="RelatedPosts-module-scss-module__fDzNNG__root"
